merge.message:
Update Hyperlight to 0.18, hyperlight-js 0.5 and hyperlight-wasm 0.16 (#46)

Update Hyperlight to 0.18.0, hyperlight-js to 0.5.0 and hyperlight-wasm
to 0.16.0.

* hyperlight-js 0.5.0 and hyperlight-wasm 0.16.0 require Hyperlight
0.18, so 0.19.0 waits for their next releases.
* Pin Wasmtime 36.0.18 and Cranelift 0.123.18 to match
hyperlight-wasm-aot 0.16.0, which compiles the AOT artifacts.
* Use typed hyperlight-wasm snapshots and the new `Sandbox` name.
* Reduce the dummy guest to its `#[guest_function]` handler. 0.18
provides defaults for the entry points it defined.

Signed-off-by: Ludvig Liljenberg <4257730+ludfjig@users.noreply.github.com>
